title: Relative bicentralizer and continuous-core commutants
exact_target: For every unital inclusion $N\subseteq M$ of von Neumann algebras with separable preduals and a faithful normal conditional expectation $M\to N$, is there a unital injective subalgebra $P\subseteq N$ and a faithful normal conditional expectation $N\to P$ for which $P\prime \cap c(M)=N\prime \cap c(M)$, where c(M) is the continuous core?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
